Re:Form Datasets
	

This repository contains the datasets used in the paper Re:Form -- Reducing Human Priors in Scalable Formal Software Verification with RL in LLMs: A Preliminary Study on Dafny.
The Re:Form project introduces a framework for code to specification generation using large language models, based on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL). reputation: A research dataset introduced with the Re:Form paper; known within the formal verification and ML-for-code research community but niche outside that area.
